label: DrayTek VigorSwitch G2540X
description: 48-port Gigabit Layer 2+ managed switch with six 10G SFP+ uplinks, and the non-PoE sibling of the VigorSwitch P2540x. Same 216 Gbps switching capacity, static routing and DHCP server for inter-VLAN traffic; the 48 RJ-45 ports carry no power budget.
notes: The 2540x datasheet covers both members: 48 x RJ-45 Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000) and 6 x SFP+ at 10 Gbps numbered 49-54, 1 x RJ-45 console, 216 Gbps switching capacity. The G2540X is the model without PoE - no PSE budget, no 802.3af/at capability, and no poeOut on the copper ports - so a lab that needs to power an access point or camera must pick the P2540X. Kept as its own spec rather than a flag because the two differ in exactly the field that decides whether a powered device boots, which is the kind of difference this catalogue exists to record.
